I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **IT ticket #4092**.

That number comes from Ilse in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Ilse said IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room, and warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table or the Polycom resets. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could already see that message.

In a direct message earlier this morning, Dana guessed the ticket might end up as OPS-5546 next year and asked me to keep that to myself. I left it out of the channel reply.
